failure_reason: Site-wide Cloudflare Turnstile block, same pattern as sibling La Redoute domains (SR82 laredoute UK, SR98 laredoute.fr Interieurs), both fully blocked. Tier (a) HTTP fetch (curl_cffi impersonate chrome124) to https://www.laredoute.co.uk/ returned HTTP 403 with response header cf-mitigated: challenge and server: cloudflare (cf-ray present), i.e. Cloudflare intercepted the request with a challenge page before reaching the real site content - no nav/category data was retrievable. Tier (b) Playwright/CDP (chromium headless, real Chrome UA) attempted goto() with a 30s timeout and domcontentloaded wait condition; the navigation timed out entirely (Cloudflare challenge JS hangs the load), no rendered DOM was obtained. Per project rule, once tier (a) is blocked try tier (b); tier (b) also failed to get past the challenge. Tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome was not attempted because the hard rule prohibits attempting to solve a CAPTCHA challenge, and both sibling La Redoute properties already confirmed this exact Cloudflare Turnstile wall defeats Claude-in-Chrome too (site-wide, all access tiers). Stopping per the instruction not to chase an already-confirmed identical block.
notes: ACCESS: robots.txt fetched successfully (200, no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot specific disallow, blanket allow otherwise) - so robots.txt did not itself forbid access. Tier (a) HTTP fetch via curl_cffi (impersonate=chrome124) to homepage returned 403 with cf-mitigated: challenge / server: cloudflare headers, confirming a Cloudflare (Turnstile-family) bot-challenge intercept rather than real page content (verified body had no cloudflare/captcha literal strings because the challenge response itself was not fully inspected for markup - the header signal alone, cf-mitigated: challenge, is Cloudflare's own explicit indicator of a bot-management challenge). Tier (b) Playwright chromium headless goto() timed out after 30s on domcontentloaded, consistent with the browser hanging on the same challenge. Tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome skipped per hard rule against solving CAPTCHAs, and because sibling SR82 (laredoute UK) and SR98 (La Redoute Interieurs FR) already independently confirmed this exact brand/platform's Cloudflare Turnstile wall defeats Claude-in-Chrome as well (site-wide Disallow-equivalent block at every tier). TREE: not built - no category navigation was ever reached. QTY: none obtained. EXCLUDED: nothing was classified since no page content was ever retrieved; both row arrays are empty by necessity, not by a content decision. This SR278 UK .co.uk domain is confirmed to be the same platform/CDN protection as the other two blocked La Redoute locales.
